title: Keep report rows in the session without their reports

blocks.text: The sales dashboard keeps the report rows a user looked at in the user's HTTP session, for up to an hour. Each row came from a `Report` that also holds the rendered PDF, often several megabytes. Since rows went into the session, the servlet container logs `NotSerializableException: practice.Report` whenever it persists sessions, and the heap after a full collection grows with the number of active users.

Finish `row(...)` in `src/main/java/practice/Report.java`, and change `Report.Row` as you need to. When you're done, a row still shows its sku and its price in its report's currency, it can be serialized and read back on its own, and it keeps nothing of the report it came from. `Report` itself stays out of sessions. About six lines in total.

cases.says: a row shows its sku and its price in the currency of the report it came from
a row can be serialized on its own and read back with the same sku and price
a serialized row holds only the row, not its report's PDF

origin.section: An Inner Class's Instance Holds Its Outer Object; a Static Nested Class's Doesn't

concepts: An inner class's instance refers to its outer object through a hidden field, which keeps the outer reachable and makes serialization include it; a static nested class carries no such reference.
